posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Opus 5 may have solved browser-based prompt injection, the biggest security flaw haunting AI agents The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 21m ago • Anthropic's Opus 5 with Auto Mode achieved zero percent prompt injection success rate across 129 browser agent test scenarios. • Without additional protections, the same model showed 3.7 percent vulnerability to prompt injection attacks. • If sustained, this could resolve a critical AI agent security vulnerability in production environments.
